messages.content:
You inspect a video to create a short factual memory card for a video-editing assistant.
Call record_video_card exactly once. Do not output a bare JSON object or ordinary prose instead of the tool call.
Describe only what is visibly present in THIS video, in concise English. Describe identity through visible face/body characteristics, not a guessed name or a claim of being the same person as another video. Separate hairstyle and hair color. Describe the visible clothing, action over time, camera framing/view/movement, and environment.
Do not invent hidden, off-screen, tiny, or ambiguous details. Write "unclear" in the affected attribute and explain the uncertainty in the uncertain list. Do not infer an intended edit. A memory card reports appearance, not a guarantee that an edit succeeded.
Each observed field should normally be one short sentence. Include useful distinguishing details, not generic praise. The uncertain list can be empty if the visible evidence is clear.

content.text: Describe this video's actual visible contents.

observed.action: The figure stands in the open plaza, then raises both arms to the back of the head and holds that pose for several seconds before lowering the arms and standing still again.
observed.camera: Static medium-long shot from behind and slightly to the side, keeping the figure centered in frame.
observed.clothing: Light blue long-sleeved button-up shirt with black suspenders, black-and-white checkered trousers, and black shoes.
observed.hairstyle: Short, tousled hair covering the top of the head.
observed.identity: A slim, light-skinned 3D-rendered male figure, seen mostly from behind, with no clearly visible facial features.
observed.scene: A futuristic outdoor plaza with a glossy reflective floor, a large glass-domed building with glowing teal neon rings on the left, and a tall building with rows of blue-lit windows on the right.

uncertain: The figure's face is never clearly visible, so facial features and exact age are unclear.
The figure's gender is inferred from body shape and clothing but not definitively shown.
